title: Start December by Retiring One Stale Obligation
teaser: Old low-value commitments can obscure what actually deserves year-end attention.
message: Find one open item that no longer creates value and close archive or remove it with a short reason.

title: Confirm One Critical Password Is Not Shared
teaser: Shared credentials make individual accountability and clean revocation much harder.
message: Check one critical account for shared-password use and outline a move to individual access if needed.

title: Put the Time Zone on One Time-Sensitive Report
teaser: A timestamp can describe a different calendar day when readers assume different zones.
message: Review one time-based report and make sure its timezone is explicit and unambiguous.

title: Verify a Reset Survives Reopening
teaser: A reset button may change the screen while leaving the stored value untouched.
message: Change one safe setting reset it to default then reopen the view and confirm persistent state also returned to default.

title: Read the Refund Terms Before One Purchase
teaser: A lower price can carry a higher practical risk when returns are difficult.
message: Before one planned purchase review the refund window mandatory fees and major exceptions.

title: Exercise a Divide-by-Zero Edge Case
teaser: Rare boundary inputs can turn ordinary output into infinity or an undefined value.
message: Pick one calculation with a user-controlled denominator and verify zero is handled safely and explicitly.

title: Use One Key Screen at a Narrow Width
teaser: Controls that overflow on small screens can make essential actions inaccessible.
message: Open one important screen at a narrow viewport and confirm its main task works without unnecessary horizontal scrolling.

title: Make the Age of the Latest Backup Obvious
teaser: Backup confidence is misleading when nobody knows how old the last successful copy is.
message: Check whether your backup flow exposes the date and time of the most recent successful backup where users can find it.

title: Export a Record Containing Special Characters
teaser: Commas quotes and line breaks reveal escaping bugs that simple sample data never triggers.
message: Create safe sample data with special characters export it and read it back to confirm every field remains intact.

title: Check That an Authorization Error Reveals Only What It Must
teaser: A denial message can leak the existence or details of a protected resource.
message: Use a safe unauthorized account against one protected area and verify the response discloses only necessary information.

title: Double-Submit One Safe Action
teaser: Fast repeated input can create duplicate records when idempotency is missing.
message: Trigger one harmless submit action twice in quick succession and verify the system does not create a duplicate side effect.

title: Separate Activity From Outcome on One Goal
teaser: Effort is not the same measurement as the result the effort was meant to produce.
message: Take one December goal and write its planned activity and measurable outcome on separate lines.

title: Inspect the Reading Order of One Screen
teaser: Visual placement and accessibility order can diverge enough to change meaning.
message: Walk through one key screen in screen-reader order and confirm headings fields errors and actions form a coherent sequence.

title: Recheck the License of One Dependency
teaser: A version upgrade can alter licensing or redistribution conditions.
message: Choose one external dependency and verify the license of the exact version currently used from its authoritative source.

title: Retest One Mid-December Assumption
teaser: A plan should not preserve an assumption after the evidence underneath it changes.
message: Select one important assumption in active work and test it against the most current evidence you have.

title: Separate Cold and Warm Performance Numbers
teaser: Caching can make later runs look better while hiding the first experience users actually feel.
message: For one startup or query measurement record the first run separately from subsequent warmed runs.

title: Store an Integrity Hash Beside One Artifact
teaser: A filename can stay constant while the underlying bytes change.
message: Generate an appropriate SHA-256 hash for one critical artifact and store it with the version record.

title: Add Reproduction Steps to One Bug
teaser: A symptom without a reproducible path is difficult for another person to investigate.
message: For one open defect record the starting state exact steps expected result and observed result.

title: Check the Renewal Date of One Paid Service
teaser: Automatic renewal can carry unused services into another billing period.
message: Review one paid service and note its next renewal date plus the practical cancellation deadline.

title: Try an Impossible Day in a Date Field
teaser: A string can match YYYY-MM-DD syntax and still fail the Gregorian calendar.
message: Enter a day such as the thirty-first of a thirty-day month in a safe test and confirm the application rejects it.

title: Inspect Metadata Before Sharing One File
teaser: Files can carry author device or location information beyond what is visible on the page.
message: Review a sample file before sharing and remove unnecessary metadata when the workflow allows it.

title: Define a Backup Communication Channel for One Critical Process
teaser: A single communication channel can turn its outage into a coordination outage.
message: Record the alternate channel a team will use if the primary route is unavailable during one important process.

title: Prove You Can Find Something Inside an Archive
teaser: Having an archive is not the same as being able to retrieve from it efficiently.
message: Search for one older record by date or keyword and verify you can locate it within a reasonable amount of effort.

title: Read One Handoff Note With Fresh Eyes
teaser: Authors silently fill gaps from memory that a new reader cannot see.
message: Review one handoff as if you knew nothing about the project and add the missing context needed to start.

title: Refresh a Filtered View and Observe State
teaser: Unexpected state loss forces users to rebuild their work after every refresh.
message: Apply a filter refresh the view and verify persistence or deliberate reset matches the product's stated behavior.

title: Test the Upper Length Boundary of One Text Field
teaser: Very long input can expose overflow storage and performance problems.
message: Use safe data near one field's maximum length and confirm the interface responds predictably at the boundary.

title: Look for Missing Periods in One Year-End Series
teaser: A plausible annual total can still hide gaps in the underlying timeline.
message: Before trusting one yearly series count the expected days or periods and compare them with what is actually present.

title: Inspect Logs for Sensitive Values
teaser: Debugging records become a security liability when they contain passwords tokens or personal data.
message: Trigger one safe event inspect its logs and confirm sensitive values are omitted or appropriately masked.

title: Limit What You Carry Into January
teaser: Moving every unfinished task forward is accumulation not prioritization.
message: Cap the work you will carry into January at a realistic capacity and deliberately reconsider the rest.

title: Identify the Year's Highest-Value Check
teaser: Frequent checks do not all catch equally important problems.
message: Choose the recurring check that found the most useful defect or risk this year and record why it earned its place.

title: Close the Year With One Verifiable Result
teaser: A general feeling of progress does not tell you what should be repeated.
message: Choose one concrete improvement from the year and link it to a measurement source or test result that can be checked again.
